frozen_codes.CANDIDATE_REFUSED:ACTION_COMPOSITION_UNR: two differing ECONOMICALLY_ADJUDICATED kinds on the unit's relevant session. The frozen model defines no composition semantics; no ordering and no combined return is invented.
frozen_codes.CANDIDATE_REFUSED:ACTION_KIND_UNADJUDICA: the unit's relevant session carries an action kind whose Phase-3B semantics are not established.
frozen_codes.CANDIDATE_REFUSED:IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED: the unit's symbol has no registered CIK, or resolves ambiguously in the crosswalk. Scoped to the per-symbol identity condition ONLY - see freeze 4. It must NOT be overloaded with global integrity failures.

freeze_1_bridge_refusal_namespace.not_adopted: v1.1 proposed CANDIDATE_REFUSED:ACTION_KIND_UNKNOWN as a separate code. Superseded by the discriminator above.

required_discriminator.alternative_if_vetoed: add a fourth code CANDIDATE_REFUSED:ACTION_KIND_UNKNOWN and drop the discriminator. Functionally equivalent; flagged so the choice is the owner's.
required_discriminator.status: FROZEN, flagged - this is the one place this record resolves an ambiguity the rulings did not address.
required_discriminator.why_it_is_required: the frozen gates treat these two differently and irreconcilably - an unknown vendor kind fails qualification at incidence > 0, while a known-unadjudicated kind is gated at 1% / 5 symbols. A single undifferentiated code makes the gates uncomputable. The owner froze THREE names; this discriminator honours that count rather than adding a fourth code.

freeze_1_bridge_refusal_namespace.ruling: APPROVED as a separate namespace. spq1/refusals.py and REFUSAL_CODES are NOT to be modified - that would change a bound R-PROD producer contract. Bridge-level refusals are a different semantic class and remain outside SignalRefusal.

freeze_2_unit_refusal_census_deliverable.acknowledged_limit: the bridge inspects only rows relevant to a unit, so a kind appearing exclusively on tickers or sessions no unit touches is never vocabulary-checked. That is the direct cost of unit scope and is the correct trade - it is precisely the whole-table sensitivity that spent opening 3 - but it means the census evidences the INSPECTED vocabulary, not the partition's full vocabulary. Do not report it as the latter.
freeze_2_unit_refusal_census_deliverable.current_state_being_fixed: ProducerCandidateSource.refusals is collected at candidates.py:146,177 and read only by tests. runner.py, census.py and publish.py never touch it.

frozen_denominators.both_denominators_published: units_enumerated is published alongside, so any ratio can be recomputed on either base without re-running.
frozen_denominators.eligible_candidate_units: units_enumerated MINUS units_producer_refused - the population whose semantics the BRIDGE is responsible for. This is the denominator for every percentage gate.
frozen_denominators.note_on_ordering: IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED arises inside _produce() BEFORE the producer's own eligibility evaluation, so such a unit is bridge-refused and IS counted in eligible_candidate_units. Recorded because the alternative reading would quietly shrink the gate denominator.
frozen_denominators.reconciliation_identity: units_enumerated == units_producer_refused + units_bridge_refused + units_accepted. The existing suite already asserts the two-term form (records_examined + refusals == units); this is its three-term generalisation.

freeze_2_unit_refusal_census_deliverable.rationale: once refusal moves to unit scope, refusal incidence is load-bearing evidence. Without it the run can PASS while silently discarding a material share of candidates - a visible abort traded for an invisible one.
freeze_2_unit_refusal_census_deliverable.ruling: REQUIRED. A governed deliverable, not a test-only field.
freeze_2_unit_refusal_census_deliverable.vocabulary_census_is_implied_not_added: the unknown-kind gate is stated as 'incidence > 0', which cannot be evaluated without enumerating the action vocabulary the run actually inspected. observed_action_vocabulary and unregistered_action_kinds_observed are therefore requirements OF that gate, not an extension of it. They are EVIDENCE ONLY and can never abort a run - behaviour remains governed by unit scope.

freeze_3_materiality_gates.combination_rule: each reason breaches if EITHER its unit-fraction OR its unique-symbol count is exceeded. 'Whichever occurs first' describes which trips in practice; the frozen predicate is the disjunction.

ACTION_KIND_UNADJUDICATED__UNKNOWN_VOCAB.rule: HARD FAIL at incidence > 0, on either refused units or unregistered kinds observed
ACTION_KIND_UNADJUDICATED__UNKNOWN_VOCAB.why_zero: this is not ordinary candidate attrition. A single unregistered label means the vocabulary that the whole classifier is keyed on is not closed, which is a governance failure rather than a measurement.

IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED.why_larger: unresolved crosswalk identity is an already-recognised property of the crosswalk, which deliberately leaves ambiguity unarbitrated. The larger ceiling is operational, and it is still a ceiling.

freeze_3_materiality_gates.nature: QUALIFICATION gates, not economic tolerances. They bound how much of the analyzable population may vanish into semantic uncertainty before the result stops being evidence.
freeze_3_materiality_gates.owner_note_recorded: the owner observed that a cleaner rule would be 'any systematic refusal class that changes the analyzable population by more than de minimis blocks the opening', and chose explicit thresholds for reproducible qualification. Recorded so a later reviewer sees the numbers as a deliberate choice, not an arbitrary one.

freeze_4_identity_unresolved_is_unit_sco.evidence: cik_by_symbol_from() deliberately leaves an ambiguous symbol out of by_symbol, and its docstring states the intent: the caller should be able to COUNT how many securities that affected instead of wondering where they went. The intent was always per-unit; only the implementation was per-run (candidates.py:230 raises inside _produce(), which candidates() does not catch).
freeze_4_identity_unresolved_is_unit_sco.mapping: no registered CIK for X -> CANDIDATE_REFUSED:IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED
remains_RUN_REFUSE: the crosswalk source cannot be loaded
freeze_4_identity_unresolved_is_unit_sco.ruling: AUTHORIZED as unit scope, frozen SEPARATELY from the action-kind rulings rather than generalised from them.

freeze_5_catch_boundary.requirement: the per-unit catch boundary in candidates.py must cover BOTH SignalRefusal and the bridge-level CandidateRefused, and it must enclose _facts() - which today runs OUTSIDE the existing try/except at candidates.py:174-179.
freeze_5_catch_boundary.ruling: the ACTIONS lookup moves to _facts() time and is evaluated ONLY for the current unit. It must not be precomputed in a way that lets an irrelevant ticker abort the run.

implementation_status.state: UNBLOCKED on the four frozen items; ONE open item (GATE-TIMING) remains

open_item_gate_evaluation_timing.proposed_frozen_reading: evaluate in BOTH places with different meanings. (a) In pre-sealed qualification against fixtures: prove every gate FIRES and every code is REACHABLE - this qualifies the gate, not the population. (b) In the governed run: a breach makes the published result INADMISSIBLE as research evidence and is a governance finding.
open_item_gate_evaluation_timing.statement: the gates are stated as QUALIFICATION thresholds, but the population they measure only exists during the governed run. Pre-sealed qualification runs on fixtures, where incidence is whatever the fixture author constructed.
open_item_gate_evaluation_timing.status: OPEN - one owner confirmation needed before implementation
open_item_gate_evaluation_timing.the_limit_that_cannot_be_engineered_away: a breach discovered during the governed run CANNOT un-spend the opening. The gate protects the INTERPRETATION of a result, not the opening itself. Anything claiming to block an opening on population evidence would have to read the partition first, which is the thing the opening exists to authorise. Stated plainly so the gate is not mistaken for a pre-flight control it cannot be.
